mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (title, category, source_type, source_uri, city, district, status, chunk_count, content_hash, version, content, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUri}, #{city}, #{district}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{contentHash}, #{version}, #{content}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_document WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, title, category, source_type, source_uri, city, district, status, chunk_count, content_hash, version, error_msg, created_by, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_document ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = #{status}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
